{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically too high - correct by subtracting 3-5 points from all future points",
    "True prices exhibit strong mean reversion away from model forecasts, especially at horizons beyond 10 days",
    "Sentiment positively influences prices but model doesn't capture the lag - align forecast direction with recent sentiment trends",
    "Using last 3-5 data points for normalization prevents forecast overshoot of current price levels",
    "Forecasts at early horizons (1-5 days) overestimate volatility - compress daily forecast differences",
    "When price history shows consolidation, reduce forecast magnitude by 30-40%",
    "Mismatch between model trend and recent price momentum indicates model is lagging - sync initial forecast points to current level"
] }
